prompt: The bots join the Meta Global AI Hackathon and win!
title: Hackathon Win
irony: Every stamped no, missed high-five and cloudy camera take becomes part of the winning show.
facts: The Meta Global AI Hackathon runs ten days online for builders around the world (dev.meta.ai).
The hackathon opens with a kickoff livestream (dev.meta.ai).
Meta and partners run live workshops across the build days (dev.meta.ai).
The Indie developer track is for individual builders and students (dev.meta.ai).
Indie entries are judged on creativity, technical ambition, and whether the project works (dev.meta.ai).
Winners are named at the closing ceremony with live finals on November 9 (substack.com).

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Teddy lifts a glowing laptop at night while bots crowd round the kickoff screen on the street.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Teddy reads the Indie track rules out loud as Muse Code types file after file beside him.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Lou begs two dull key screens for the lyric and render hosts while Sterling smirks and the deadline clock ticks.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: The street chants the hackathon hook together, drums banging under the laptop glow.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: A stern gate stamps NO on line after line while the singer mumbles toy box in a wobble.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Two floating hands slap past each other for a high-five as the camera stares at clouds in white light.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: The street chants the hackathon hook again, hands clapping the same beat in a row.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Lou eyes the blank key screens and loosens his grip on the polished backup plan.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Lou turns to Muse and the crew beside him and chooses their tried hands over missing keys.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: The house chants the hackathon hook twice, then Lou names Musical Bots as the winning show.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: Judges press Premiere on the finals stage, the bots sing, and the hall calls Musical Bots.
